title: Broadcom earnings beat by $0.03, revenue topped estimates
snippet: Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) reported third quarter EPS of $1.24, $0.03 better than the analyst estimate of $1.21. Revenue for the quarter came in at $13.07B

title: Goldman says Broadcom earnings were just a hiccup and to buy the dip
snippet: Goldman Sachs said investors should not pull the plug on Broadcom after its latest earnings report. Analyst Toshiya Hari reiterated a buy rating on the semiconductor and infrastructure software supplier on Friday. Hari's $190 price target implies shares can rally 24% from Thursday's closing level. Hari's call comes one day after Broadcom posted fiscal third-quarter earnings that beat analysts' estimates for both revenue and earnings.
